2027-05-20.line: born, awakened and passing away: all on this full moon.
2027-05-20.meaning: Theravada Buddhists remember the Buddha's birth, awakening and passing on Vesak. lanterns, offerings and kind deeds fill the day. the date differs by country. (date may vary by a day)
2027-05-20.source: Vesak (Visakha Puja), full moon of Vesakha

2027-06-04.title: Clearing the slate
2027-06-04.meaning: monks clear their consciences together before the recitation. a lovely model for lay life too. (date may vary by a day)

2027-06-19.title: Moon in still water
2027-06-19.line: the moon is clearest in still water.
2027-06-19.meaning: a calm mind reflects truth best. a few still minutes tonight is a perfect offering. (date may vary by a day)

2027-07-04.title: The hidden moon
2027-07-04.line: what is unseen still moves the tides.
2027-07-04.meaning: quiet practice changes us below the surface, like the moon pulling the sea. (date may vary by a day)

2027-07-18.title: Dhamma Day
2027-07-18.line: the wheel of the teaching begins to turn.
2027-07-18.meaning: Asalha Puja remembers the Buddha's first sermon to five companions in the Deer Park, on the middle way and the four noble truths. (date may vary by a day)

2027-07-19.title: Vassa begins
2027-07-19.line: three months to slow down and go deeper.
2027-07-19.meaning: monks settle in one place for the rains retreat. many lay Buddhists take on a small extra practice for these months. what might yours be? (date may vary by a day)

2027-08-02.title: Dark sky, clear mind
2027-08-02.line: darkness can be restful, not frightening.
2027-08-02.meaning: a dark night invites rest. let your mind settle like the sky. (date may vary by a day)

2027-08-16.title: Ullambana
2027-08-16.line: gratitude reaches back to all who came before us.
2027-08-16.meaning: in East Asia, Ullambana (Vu Lan) honors parents and ancestors, after Maudgalyayana's story of helping his mother. a day to thank family, near or gone. (date may vary by a day)
2027-08-16.source: Ullambana Sutra; Chinese lunar calendar, 7th month, 15th day

2027-08-17.title: A night to sit
2027-08-17.line: sit under the full moon, even for a few minutes.
2027-08-17.meaning: many temples hold night meditation. join in from wherever you are. (date may vary by a day)

2027-08-31.title: Simple living
2027-08-31.line: take only what you need today.
2027-08-31.meaning: observance days are for simplicity. notice the ease of needing less. (date may vary by a day)

2027-09-15.title: Full moon, full heart
2027-09-15.line: may this full moon fill your heart with peace.
2027-09-15.meaning: wishing peace on a full moon is a sweet practice. share it with all beings. (date may vary by a day)

2027-09-30.title: Inner light
2027-09-30.line: when outer light is low, turn on the inner one.
2027-09-30.meaning: kindness and attention glow on their own. let them light this day. (date may vary by a day)

2027-10-15.title: Pavarana again
2027-10-15.line: the retreat ends; the doors open; the giving begins.
2027-10-15.meaning: the end of Vassa brings Kathina, when lay people offer new robes to monks. a joyful festival of generosity. (date may vary by a day)
2027-10-15.source: Pavarana Day and Kathina, Theravada tradition

2027-10-29.title: A night for metta
2027-10-29.line: send good wishes into the dark, to everyone, everywhere.
2027-10-29.meaning: loving-kindness on a dark night is like a lantern for the world. (date may vary by a day)

2027-11-14.title: Moonlit walk
2027-11-14.meaning: walking meditation under the moon is gentle and beautiful. let each step be quiet. (date may vary by a day)

2027-11-28.title: Waxing again
2027-11-28.line: tomorrow the moon begins to grow again.
2027-11-28.meaning: endings lead to beginnings. whatever was hard can start to brighten. (date may vary by a day)

2027-12-08.title: Rohatsu
2027-12-08.line: the morning star rose, and the Buddha saw clearly.
2027-12-08.meaning: Zen communities often sit through the night before Rohatsu. even five quiet minutes today honors the Buddha's awakening.

2027-12-13.title: Renewal
2027-12-13.line: each full moon is a chance to begin the month fresh.
2027-12-13.meaning: Buddhist monastics renew their training on full and new moons. you can renew yours too. (date may vary by a day)

2027-12-27.title: Listening to quiet
2027-12-27.line: a moonless night is good for listening.
2027-12-27.meaning: listen to the night sounds for a minute. presence lives in quiet moments. (date may vary by a day)
